craft_notes: Sthāyin: other-body (empathy as method: perceive THERE, regard-of-own LEFT). Rows: row 3 (left→pervasive may be). Close: may be (optative — pervasion granted). Rejected: 'telepathy' — killed: perceives awareness kept (anubhāvayet as experiencing); 'altruism' — killed: regard-left kept (apekṣā tyaktvā — not generosity, de-centering).

lines: Like self in other's body — He perceives awareness:
own-body-regard left — pervasive in days may be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: svavad anyaśarīre =B9pi saṃvittim anubhāvayet | apekṣāṃ svaśarīrasya tyaktvā vyāpī dinair bhavet

reads_against.argmap: What happens in another's body? → Perceiving self in other bodies, regard of one's own dissolves — pervasive.
c1_essence: Self in other's body: own-body-regard dissolved, pervasive.
